title: EMI EDI: electrodeionization after RO | Aquemi
meta: The EMI EDI skid polishes RO permeate by electrodeionization to the conductivity your standard names, designed to meet USP <645>, with no regeneration chemicals.
headline: Ions out, no regeneration chemicals
lead: The EDI skid polishes reverse osmosis (RO) permeate by electrodeionization (EDI) to the conductivity your standard names, designed to meet USP <645>. Its instruments wire to the control panel on the RO skid.
primary_cta_intent: I have water data, no system yet|Sizing proposal|EDI skid

blocks.h: How water moves through the skid
blocks.intro: The skid starts at the RO permeate connection and ends at the storage inlet. Sample points: set in your design.

stages.label: Feed
stages.d: Arrives from the RO skid at [RO permeate conductivity, µS/cm], low enough for EDI.

stages.label: EDI
stages.d: A direct current drives the remaining ions through membranes into a concentrate stream. The resin in the dilute cells keeps working without regeneration chemicals.

stages.label: Reject
stages.d: Recycled to the RO feed or sent to drain, set in your design.

stages.label: Out
stages.d: Water out of specification does not reach storage: it goes to a route set in your design until it recovers.

blocks.intro: Your proposal marks each option included or priced.

items.d: Where you already make RO permeate, the EDI skid is supplied with the control panel the RO skid would carry.
Circulates when storage is full, so water does not stand in the stack.
After EDI, where microbial margin is needed. Ultraviolet (UV) lowers the viable count; it does not sanitize.

items.q: Do we need EDI, or is RO enough?
items.a: Your limit decides. The RO skid alone reaches [RO permeate conductivity, µS/cm]. Where your standard asks for less, the EDI skid takes it to [EDI outlet conductivity guarantee, µS/cm @ 25 °C].

items.q: Where is the EDI skid's control panel?
items.a: On the RO skid. The EDI skid's instruments and valves wire to that panel, so one controller runs both. An EDI skid supplied without an RO skid comes with the panel.

items.q: Can we add the EDI skid later?
items.a: Yes. The RO skid's panel and piping are designed with the EDI connection in place. Adding it to a qualified system goes through your change control.

cta.h: Send your limit. Get a sized EDI skid.
cta.body: An engineer replies in writing. Cost: discussed when you enquire.
